entries.08563257661dee5b: A business in which the company and its consolidated subsidiaries sell products at stores such as home centers. The group is a single segment consisting only of this business, and there is no description by segment. As of the end of February 2026, the group had 669 stores: 520 of the company, 94 of Ken Depot Co., Ltd. (of which 3 are franchise stores), 34 of Home Improvement Hirose Co., Ltd., 4 of Home Center Mitsuwa Co., Ltd., and KOHNAN VIETNAM CO., LTD.17 stores. Ken Depot Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of building materials, and Home Improvement Hirose Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of housing-related goods and food. Products are disclosed in 5 product divisions.
entries.187baf1f24a3c930: This department handles dining products, interior goods, electrical materials and lighting, daily necessities, storage products, pharmaceuticals, footwear and apparel, household goods, home appliances, and nursing care products. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥158,928 million (104.2% year on year).
entries.2662109067ce6872: These are the businesses that [Business Description] lists under the category “Other (Distribution-related Services, etc.).” It includes consolidated subsidiary I'nT Holdings Co., Ltd., which manages a subsidiary running the EC business for interior products, as well as non-consolidated subsidiaries Osaka HC Co., Ltd., Yūgen Kaisha Minami Ōsawa In (anonymous partnership), Kohnan Business Innovation Co., Ltd., and Sazan Pōtorain Co., Ltd.
